description:
Title: OEE

Write a process, that collects relevant information from a machine, and calculated the Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE).
If the OEE falls below a certain value/percentage, stop the machine and send an email to an engineer.
When the machine is restarted, continue measuring.
When the machine is disconnected, stop the process.

  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_MachineDisconnected" name="Machine disconnected"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectData" name="Collect relevant information from machine"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CalculateOEE" name="Calculate Overall Equipment Efficiency (OEE)"/>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_StopMachine" name="Stop machine"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendEmail" name="Send email to engineer"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_MachineRestarted" name="Machine restarted">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Restarted" messageRef="Message_MachineRestarted"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:subProcess id="EventSubprocess_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" triggeredByEvent="true">
      <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Disconnected" name="Machine disconnected" isInterrupting="true">
        <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_Disconnected" messageRef="Message_MachineDisconnected"/>
      </bpmn:startEvent>
      <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_ProcessStopped" name="Process stopped">
        <bpmn:terminateEventDefinition id="TerminateEventDef_Stopped"/>
      </bpmn:endEvent>
      <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disconnected_Stop" sourceRef="StartEvent_Disconnected" targetRef="EndEvent_ProcessStopped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_Loop" sourceRef="StartEvent_OEE" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Loop_Collect" sourceRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge" targetRef="Task_CollectData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Collect_Calculate" sourceRef="Task_CollectData" targetRef="Task_CalculateOEE"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Calculate_Split" sourceRef="Task_CalculateOEE" targetRef="Gateway_OEE_Split"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_Above" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_OEE_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Email_Restart" sourceRef="Task_SendEmail" targetRef="Event_MachineRestarted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Restart_Loop" sourceRef="Event_MachineRestarted" targetRef="Gateway_Loop_Merge"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
